extensions.source: ../DESIGN.md; src/main/res/values, values-night, values-w600dp, layout-w600dp; DeskUi.kt and ReadableWidthLayout.kt

nativeColors.resolution: Theme.Material3.DayNight maps tm_* resources from values/colors.xml and values-night/colors.xml through Material roles. Frontmatter -night suffix describes the resource qualifier, not a separate resource name.
nativeColors.contrast: Explicit custom light/dark schemes; no increased-contrast palette or dynamic wallpaper color implementation.

wordmark.purpose: Existing assets/fonts/wickhop-handwriting.ttf through CustomTypefaceSpan in Utilities.makeTitleString.

breakpoints.name: expanded-available-width
breakpoints.value: w600dp: 600dp minimum available width; values-w600dp and layout-w600dp

nativeLayout.detail: Bottom navigation becomes leading rail; one page at a time, no pinned Summary pane.
nativeLayout.largeText: Native font scaling, scrolling and wrap-content rows; Search label/spinner rows stay horizontal with 2:3 weights.
nativeLayout.insets: System-bar/cutout left and right padding; optional bottom max(system bars, IME).

motion.name: confirmation-feedback
motion.purpose: DeskUi.confirmHaptic requests platform feedback; no custom timing.

extensions.nativeAssets: New drawable XML: ic_barberpole_mark, ic_play, ic_pause, ic_stop and ic_play_pause selector. Existing shipping rasters and handwriting font unchanged; barber-pole mark reuses established identity, not stock art.
extensions.rendering: Native descriptions only. No web component previews or synthesized tonal ramps.

components.name: Home action
components.description: Material3 tonal MaterialButton, TitleMedium, start alignment, 48dp minimum height, 16dp horizontal padding, 12dp icon padding; Find a tag overrides primary/on-primary colors.

components.name: Search field
components.description: Outlined Material3 TextInputLayout and TextInputEditText with search icon and IME actionSearch.

components.name: Search filters
components.description: Native Spinners alongside LabelMedium field labels in horizontal 2:3 weighted rows.

components.name: Tag ID dialog
components.description: Native alert with outlined numeric input; inline validation leaves invalid input open.

components.name: Desk navigation
components.description: Labeled Material bottom bar or leading rail, synchronized with ViewPager2 through shared menu IDs.

components.name: Part player
components.description: 48dp Play/Pause and Stop icon buttons, loading indicator and position/balance SeekBars; checked-state XML selects Pause.

components.name: Readable content
components.description: ReadableWidthLayout centers children within width-qualified caps while preserving exact outer parent width.

narrative.overview: A charcoal action bar and handwriting title preserve Tag Master's identity. Blue marks actions; Material 3 supplies native fields, buttons and navigation. The barber pole becomes an icon-scale mark rather than a full-screen watermark.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal identity chrome with blue Material actions.
Readable-width content beside labeled native navigation.
Handwriting titles paired with native reading and control typography.

rules.name: The Native Role Rule
rules.body: Request theme attributes such as `colorPrimary`, `colorSurface` and `colorOnSurface`; let the single `Theme.Material3.DayNight` mapping select resource values.

rules.name: The Native Reading Rule
rules.body: Keep handwriting in identity and use Material text appearances for reading and controls.

rules.name: The Available Width Rule
rules.body: Select native bar or rail through width-qualified resources and cap the reading area independently.

dos: Do preserve Home, Browse, Search, Favorites, Teachable Tags, Summary, Details, Tracks and Videos terminology alongside BarbershopTags.com attribution.
Do use DayNight theme roles, readable-width wrappers and native labeled controls.
donts: Don't import Pitch Perfect's visual rules into Tag Master.
Don't describe the tablet rail as an iOS-style split Summary workspace.
Don't canonize isolated legacy styling or unsampled shared-library internals as reusable system rules.
